title: View-skew rot: doctor compares the generator banner, so every cut leaves every untouched view skewed until something re-renders it
body: Doctor compares the generator banner, so every cut leaves every untouched view skewed until something re-renders it, and the next preflight refuses again. Either doctor ignores the version stamp when comparing, or the stamp step re-renders every realised view (the schema-faces shape). A structural candidate; hv's to rule the shape. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
